scope: the exact 15 selected canonical evidence records

ideas.title: Joint Optimization of Pose and Uncertainty
ideas.text: Pose and uncertainty must be optimized together rather than sequentially or independently.

ideas.title: Uncertainty-aware dynamic reconstruction
ideas.text: A synthetic sparse-view protocol for uncalibrated feed-forward 3D Gaussian splatting that reconstructs time-varying scenes from six to twelve uncalibrated views while exposing uncertainty that tracks geometric failure.

ideas.title: Uncertainty contract
ideas.text: Each Gaussian carries appearance, opacity, motion, and covariance estimates, evaluated using calibration error and risk-coverage curves in addition to image quality.

principles.title: Calibration Validity
principles.text: Uncertainty estimates are considered valid if the expected calibration error does not exceed 0.10.

principles.title: Selective Reconstruction Utility
principles.text: Uncertainty estimates are useful if rejecting uncertain elements improves the median rendering error.

ideas.title: Geometry-conditioned feed-forward reconstruction
ideas.text: A feed-forward network predicts per-view 3D Gaussian parameters, camera hypotheses, and heteroscedastic uncertainty from sparse uncalibrated images.

ideas.title: Geometric constraints for reconstruction
ideas.text: The reconstruction process is guided by specific geometric constraints including pose, epipolar, depth-order, and motion consistency.

items.title: FreeSplatter: Pose-free Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-view 3D Reconstruction

principles.title: Pixel-Alignment for Pose-Free Gaussian Splatting
principles.text: Enforcing pixel alignment via cosine similarity maximization between predicted Gaussian rays and camera rays improves rendering quality and facilitates pose estimation.

takeaways.title: Superiority over Pose-Dependent LRMs
takeaways.text: FreeSplatter-O outperforms pose-dependent Large Reconstruction Models (LGM, InstantMesh) that use ground truth camera poses.

items.title: Diff3R: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Uncertainty-aware Differentiable Optimization

takeaways.title: Bridging Feed-Forward and Optimization
takeaways.text: Learning optimal initializations for test-time optimization via differentiable layers combines speed and quality.

takeaways.title: Uncertainty Control for Robustness
takeaways.text: Adaptive parameter change control mitigates overfitting and improves robustness.

items.title: GIFSplat: Generative Prior-Guided Iterative Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Views

takeaways.title: Iterative Refinement for Sparse Views
takeaways.text: Forward-only residual updates driven by rendering evidence can effectively refine 3D scenes from sparse inputs.

items.title: AnchorSplat: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with 3D Geometric Priors

principles.title: Decoupling from 2D Grid
principles.text: Pixel-aligned formulations entangle Gaussian representations with input images, leading to redundant primitives in plain regions and insufficient coverage in complex areas.

principles.title: Efficiency via Sparsity
principles.text: Using a sparse set of 3D anchors significantly reduces the number of required Gaussians compared to dense pixel-aligned approaches.

items.title: Uncertainty-Aware Normal-Guided Gaussian Splatting for Surface Reconstruction from Sparse Image Sequences

takeaways.title: Performance in Sparse Sequences
takeaways.text: UNG-GS significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both sparse and dense sequences.
